identity.matching: The independent positive of the password-bytes family (CVE-2025-22228's 72-byte limit): the shared concern is the password's UTF-8 representation, characters against bytes. This pair adds no length restriction of its own, and encoding preservation is no authentication policy. Only the BCrypt.hashpw(String,String) entry is selected: the three-file patch also changes the cached charset in crypto.codec.Utf8 and a test utility.
